stem:
The number line represents a distance of 1 foot.

On which of these number lines does point H represent \( \frac{1}{2} \) foot?

options.label: F
options.text: Number line with 1 foot divided into 2 segments; point H is at the first segment after 0.

options.label: G
options.text: Number line with 1 foot divided into 3 segments; point H is at the second segment after 0.

options.label: H
options.text: Number line with 1 foot divided into 4 segments; point H is at the first segment after 0.

options.label: J
options.text: Number line with 1 foot divided into 5 segments; point H is at the second segment after 0.

visual_elements: Number line F with midpoint labeled H at 1/2 foot
Number line G with H at 2/3 foot
Number line H with H at 1/4 foot
Number line J with H at 2/5 foot
difficulty_rationale: Requires understanding fractions on number lines and comparing segment divisions to identify the correct half-foot mark.
